categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Touches AddrMan connection and tried-table logic in src/addrman.cpp and src/net.cpp with the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Prevents feeler connections from stalling for up to 40 minutes when pending tried-table collisions involve networks that are no longer reachable. As noted by the author after switching a dual-homed node to `-onlynet=ipv4`, selecting an unreachable tried entry consumes retry attempts without dialing, blocking all feeler rounds until the test window elapses. While feelers are important for address book health and eclipse resistance, this failure condition is confined to specific reachability reconfigurations and is reasonably deferrable.
